style.styleTitle: Nkuku Set of 4 Mishti Tree Christmas Baubles
style.toneOfVoice: These iron baubles feature a striking tree silhouette with an antique brass finish, bringing warmth along with character to any festive display. Their slim profile make them ideal for hanging on branches or incorporating into decorative arrangements. Finished with vibrant sari ties, they add a touch of colour and texture to seasonal styling. Each Sari tie is one of a kind, so the piece you receive will vary slightly from the images shown, due to its individual character and handmade. Dimensions(mm): Height: 130. Width: 70. Depth: 10.
